revertBatchesSharedBridge(address,uint25.details: When the _newLastBatch is equal to the number of committed batches, only the precommitment is erased. NOTE: Doesn't delete the stored data about batches, but only decreases counters that are responsible for the number of batches

params._newLastBatch: batch number after which batches should be reverted

devdoc.title: ZK chain Executor contract capable of processing events emitted in the ZK chain protocol.

BatchPrecommitmentSet(uint256,uint256,by.notice: Emitted when a new precommitment is set for a batch.

BlockCommit(uint256,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Event emitted when a batch is committed

BlockExecution(uint256,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Event emitted when a batch is executed

BlocksRevert(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Event emitted when batches are reverted

BlocksVerification(uint256,uint256).notice: Event emitted when batches are verified

commitBatchesSharedBridge(address,uint25.notice: Function called by the operator to commit new batches. It is responsible for: - Verifying the correctness of their timestamps. - Processing their L2->L1 logs. - Storing batch commitments.

executeBatchesSharedBridge(address,uint2.notice: The function called by the operator to finalize (execute) batches. It is responsible for: - Processing all pending operations (commpleting priority requests). - Finalizing this batch (i.e. allowing to withdraw funds from the system)

precommitSharedBridge(address,uint256,by.notice: Precommits the status of all L2 transactions for the next batch on the shared bridge.
